objective: Server round of #84: each game has its own bot strength. POST /api/games accepts an optional strength (NewGameRequest.strength), the game saves it in SQLite, GameView.strength always reports it, and every bot move for that game (the bot's first move when the player is Black, the reply after each player move, botRetry, and a bot move resumed after a restart) calls bot.chooseMove(fen, { strength }). Success: a game created with strength 800 passes 800 on every chooseMove call and still reports 800 after a restart; omitted strength gives 1400; an invalid strength answers 400 and creates nothing; the gate is clean.
contract:
Contract (api.ts is in contract_files; do not change it): NewGameRequest.strength?: number — "Bot strength, 500 to 2500 in steps of 100 (#84, FR-1). Omitted means 1400. Anything else: 400." GameView.strength?: number — "Saved with the game (NFR-14) ... The server always sends it from #84 on (optional only for older servers; absent means 1400)." BOT_STRENGTH = { min: 500, max: 2500, step: 100, default: 1400, uciEloMin: 1320 }.
Validation: valid means typeof number, Number.isInteger, min..max inclusive, and (s - min) % step === 0. Anything else (the string "800", 850, 1320, 400, 2600, null, NaN) answers 400 with a plain message naming the allowed range; no game is created and the current game is not abandoned. Use BOT_STRENGTH; do not hard-code the numbers.
chess-core is already done (PR #88, on main): SparringBot.chooseMove(fen, opts?: BotChooseOptions), with BotChooseOptions.strength?: number defaulting to BOT_STRENGTH.default. It picks the explorer buckets from the strength (explorerRatingsFor), plays UCI_Elo = strength from 1320 up, and below 1320 uses config.weakening with engine.analyze (MultiPV). It throws on an invalid strength, or below 1320 when there is no weakening block or no engine.analyze. The live engine (StockfishEngine, passed at apps/server/src/main.ts:97) has analyze, and config/tutor.json has bot.weakening (03f355b), so main.ts needs no change.
